title: Request
description: A request sent over the control endpoint. The variant is the operation kind.

oneOf.description: Read-only inspection.
Idempotent access preparation.
Attach a running context.
Narrower child binding.
Status, events, resumption.
Explicit cancellation.
Drop a consumer reference.
Revoke a grant and descendants.
Owner-channel policy action.
Complete a server-issued decision (attended sessions only).
Attended confirmation of the current time (attended sessions only).

Graceful runtime stop (owner principal, control endpoint, any session;
needs the negotiated `service-control/1` capability).

Projection setup (M02; needs `setup/1`, offered since the activation change
set).
Catalog change (M02; needs `setup/1`).

AccountName.description: Remote account name on a destination.

oneOf.description:
Launch a program without a shell under the binding (spec §10.4). The runtime
never launches; the CLI does. `argv` never crosses IPC (Q8, ADR-0007 §8):
the request names the resolved executable and the holder process.
Produce a bound consumer configuration for a consumer Heimdall cannot launch.

Capability.description: Credential capabilities a caller may request (spec §7.2).

oneOf.description: SSH user authentication.
Git commit/tag signing (never implied by authentication; spec §7.2).
Agent forwarding (explicit, disabled by default; spec §8.5).
Create or replace a destination.
Remove a destination.
Adopt an existing identity.
Remove an adopted identity.
Create or replace a profile.
Remove a profile.

Declare an identity's interaction; always creates a `DeclareInteraction`
decision (QR1), completed only by an attended `decide`.

Withdraw a declaration (narrowing; no decision). Answered with
[`WithdrawDeclarationData`].

revision.description:
Expected revision: with it the withdrawal is a compare-and-swap, and a
newer declaration stays live (`withdrawn: false`).

ConfirmTimeRequest.description:
Attended owner confirmation of the current wall time to resolve
`TIME_UNCERTAIN` after a reboot or sync loss (ADR-0005 §3.6). Never moves a
deadline; never rebuilds a budget. Attended sessions only.

observed_wall.description:
The wall time the owner confirms as correct now (RFC 3339 with offset). It
must agree with the runtime's own wall clock within tolerance; the owner
cannot set time, only vouch for it.

ConflictKind.description: A conflict a repair addresses (ADR-0007 §5.5, §5.7). Also a stable error reason.

oneOf.description: The user file changed since the plan.
The managed file was edited.
A marker line was edited.
A marker appears more than once.
The include block is conditional.
A target file cannot be managed (manual mode).
A managed alias collides with a user alias.
Another writer changed a file during the transaction.
Git's configuration lock is held.
A setup operation is held for the owner (ADR-0007 §5.7 outcome H).

⟨ADR-0007 §12.20 item 2⟩ A check the transaction requires could not run: B_git's
Git parse check (§5.6 step 3) with local queries disabled or no verified Git
client (§12.19 item 8). The item aborts before its commit point.

Cursor.description: Opaque, reader-scoped resumption token. Never parse it outside the runtime.

DeadlineIntent.description:
Deadline intent as given by the caller, kept verbatim so that a retry of
`--for 2h` hashes equal (spec §6.2, primitives-draft §5).

oneOf.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with explicit offset (machine requests must be unambiguous).
ISO 8601 / friendly duration string (`PT2H`, `2h`), converted once at creation.

DecideRequest.description:
Complete a pending decision (approval of added authority, a widening policy
action, or a time confirmation). Only accepted on an **attended** control
session; refused with `INTERACTION_REQUIRED` otherwise, and with
`DECISION_STALE` when the record was consumed, expired, or issued under an older
authority generation (ADR-0006 §3.1). Consume-once.

DecisionId.description: Server-issued decision record ID (ADR-0006 §3.1 attended confirmation).

DeclaredInteraction.description: The interaction an owner may declare (QR1). Only `none` exists.

oneOf.description: The key asks for no confirmation.

scope.description: Scope subset (must be within the parent).

until.description: Deadline intent (effective deadline must not exceed the parent's).

DestinationDefinitionSpec.description: How a managed destination is defined; an observed one stays in the user's file.

identity.description: The adopted identity the alias uses.

EndpointRef.description:
A reference to an agent endpoint. The locator is a path or pipe name, never a
secret; it is compared exactly (a changed locator lapses a declaration,

preview.description: Dry-run authority preview: resolved snapshot plus authority delta.

InteractionMode.description: Whether Heimdall may open prompts (spec §11.3; R-AP-06).

oneOf.description: Heimdall may present decisions on the owner channel.

executable.description:
The resolved executable: absolute, 1 to 4096 bytes, no NUL. A resolved path
that is not Unicode is refused locally (`LAUNCH_FAILED`, `refused_path`).

holder.description: The holder process (delivery metadata; not hashed).

oneOf.description: Get an operation, optionally waiting (timeout is not cancel).

wait_ms.description: Bounded wait for a terminal state.

oneOf.description: Fetch events after a cursor (or a snapshot when no cursor is given).

limit.description: Maximum events to return (bounded by the runtime).

PlanDigest.description: A plan digest: lowercase hex SHA-256 (64 characters), transparent on the wire.

oneOf.description: Pause future automatic activation.
Resume automatic activation.
Schedule a hard cutoff (RFC 3339 with offset).

at.description: Instant after which no new work activates until cleared.

oneOf.description: Clear a cutoff deliberately.
Install or re-render the projection.
Remove the projection.

items.description: The items to roll back; default both.

keep_key_files.description: Keep the materialized public key files.

oneOf.description: Repair a conflict.

operation.description:
The held operation, required for `retry_held` and `keep_held` and
refused otherwise. Their plan's digest covers the held operation's
canonical observation and each held step's content fingerprint.

ProcessHolder.description:
The process holding a binding reference: its PID and an opaque OS start-time
token, so a reused PID never counts (ADR-0007 §8). Lifecycle metadata, never
authorization; excluded from the request hash.

started_at.description: Opaque OS start-time token: 1 to 64 bytes of `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]`.

ProfileSpec.description: A profile as the caller specifies it.

ProjectionItem.description: A projection item: the OpenSSH projection or the Git include (ADR-0007 §5.4).

oneOf.description: The OpenSSH include block B and the managed file P (with key files).

oneOf.description: Render the projection again.

RequestId.description: Caller-chosen request ID; part of the idempotency key (spec §11.4).

RequiredCapabilities.description:
Minimum capability a non-interactive caller requires (spec §4.3); unmet
minimums yield `CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE`, never silently weaker access.

offline_until.description: Credentials must remain usable offline until this instant.

unattended.description:
New authentications must need no human interaction until the deadline,
including through desktop and vault lock (m02-plan §5 item 6). `unknown`
never satisfies it. Omitted when false, so M01 request hashes are unchanged.

ShutdownRequest.description:
Ask the runtime to stop (ADR-0006 §13.6 item 8; capability
[`crate::ipc::capability::SERVICE_CONTROL_V1`]).

Accepted only from the owner principal on the control endpoint (never from a
limited consumer), on any session (attended or not: stopping the service is an
availability action, not a widening of authority; a same-user process could end
the process anyway). Idempotent: a repeated request while the runtime is
draining answers `OK` again. The runtime answers `OK {"stopping": true, ...}`
first, then drains gracefully: it stops accepting, lets in-flight operations
reach a durable stage (bounded; anything still running resumes through restart
recovery), persists, removes its advertisement and endpoints, and exits 0.
Not an operation: no operation ID, no idempotency record.

Verdict.description: Verdict on a server-issued decision record (ADR-0006 §3.1).

oneOf.description: Grant exactly the recorded delta / action.
Refuse it.

WaitMode.description: Delivery preference; not part of the idempotency hash (ADR-0006 §7).

oneOf.description:
Wait up to `timeout_ms`; on timeout return the current state (timeout is
not cancellation).
Return `ACCEPTED` immediately with the operation to observe.
The owner withdrew it.
An explicit agent listing lacked the fingerprint (ADR-0007 §7; QR9).

WorkId.description:
Caller-chosen work ID; a continuing binding cannot reset its expiry by
changing it (spec §6.1).
